acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Vampires family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Thrall, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Blood-Scent Scramble Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A feral, hunched, corpse-white newly turned figure with filthy hair, rat-like teeth around clear fangs, a bloodstained shift, long clawed fingers, and an animal posture.

Signature mechanic: Red Trail: the Thrall lowers its rat-like face to a fresh blood mark, scrambles along that fixed scent line, and tackles at the end; if it reaches the mark, it feeds for one beat to ready another rush.
battlefieldDuty: Probe wound awareness with a feral crawl that follows one visible blood scent, commits both clawed hands to a pounce, and becomes vulnerable while feeding.
constructionDimensions: The T1 Thrall gains vane-cut shift strips, swept hair, and pressure-guiding claw webbing without a cloak; the garment dimension becomes a T2 coat, expands through T3–T4 collars and membrane ribs, and becomes T5 shadow-wing sails with hollow cane or clasp flutes.
Motion exposes direction through hair and hems pulling before a dash, membrane camber, pressure rings around cane gestures, and a still point at the planted claw, clasp, or throne crest.
counterplay: Step across rather than along the scent line, cover or move away from the marked wound, then punish the exposed neck and spine during the committed feed. Affinity signal: Coat or wing material snaps into one line while the controlling claw, clasp, or crest remains still; crossing its lee or striking that anchor breaks the displacement.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only wind treatment without aerodynamic tailoring, membrane changes, and force direction
Glow-only wind treatment without a still anchor or pressure behavior
Transparency that erases corpse-white anatomy and material refinement
Free-floating cloth or hair that does not indicate the chosen pursuit or command lane
identityInvariants: A tall or lengthening human silhouette retains corpse-white skin, long fingers, fangs, claws, red eyes, and an absence of warm living complexion.
Posture escalates from feral hunch to impossible stillness; higher forms widen through fitted coats, tailored cloaks, bat membrane, or shadow wings without obscuring humanlike anatomy.
Black, bone pallor, deep blood red, and aged gold remain paired with velvet, silk, brocade, polished leather, blood-glass, and bat membrane.
Blood is family-native feeding matter and lineage symbolism rather than Fire or Water affinity by itself; every use has a source, route, vessel, or recoverable feeding window.
Signet rings, high collars, jeweled clasps, medals, canes, blades, and family crests communicate authored encounter rank while exposing the hand, vessel, or crest that carries each command.
telegraph: Red eyes drop to the floor, filthy shoulders bunch above the ears, and both clawed hands spread while the nose tracks one visible line.
